summary:
摩根大通第二季營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，展現強勁的營運韌性。
• 每股盈餘達6.14美元，優於市場預期的5.80美元。
• 季度營收達528.5億美元，年增17.76%。
• 核心業務展現多元化獲利能力，淨利息收入與非利息收入皆表現穩健。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報傳遞出大型銀行基本面強健的正面訊號。對股價中短期而言屬利多，有助於維持評價水準。後續應持續追蹤總體經濟走勢、信用成本變化及資本適足率指標。

需留意：總體經濟環境不確定性可能影響未來信貸品質。；監管資本要求變動可能對資產負債表管理造成壓力。

summary_en:
JPMorgan Chase reported stronger-than-expected Q2 revenue and EPS, demonstrating robust operating resilience.
• EPS came in at $6.14, beating the estimated $5.80.
• Quarterly revenue reached $52.85 billion, representing a 17.76% YoY increase.
• Core businesses demonstrated diversified profitability with solid net interest income and non-interest revenue.

ai_view_en:
view: The report sends a positive signal on large-cap bank fundamentals. This is supportive for the stock in the near to medium term and helps sustain valuation multiples. Investors should continue tracking macroeconomic trends, credit costs, and capital adequacy metrics.

Watch：Macroeconomic uncertainties could impact future credit quality.; Regulatory capital requirement changes may pressure balance sheet management.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，受惠於穩健的營收增長與淨利超越預期。
